name: The Best Ticket Broker of Russia Cup
description:
The idea of choosing the best ticket broker in Russia and awarding the Cup originated in 2021. The desire to celebrate a truly worthy broker has already become a tradition.

And so, in 2025, the organizers of the presentation of the Cup to the Best Ticket Broker in Russia decided to perpetuate the memory of past and future winners in digital form, in the form of an NFT.
